---
title: "Metrics"
description: "Task-specific definitions used by the sblrbench validation studies."
---

Metrics are interpreted jointly and within each registered study design. No
single value establishes a universal method ranking.

## Prediction

| Metric | Preferred direction | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| Prediction correlation | Higher | Agreement between predicted and true held-out genetic values |
| Prediction MSE | Lower | Squared error against true held-out genetic values |
| Prediction NMSE | Lower | MSE divided by the variance of true held-out genetic values |
| Phenotype prediction correlation | Higher | Association with held-out phenotype, labelled separately from genetic-value accuracy |
| Calibration intercept | Toward 0 | Location agreement in `true G = intercept + slope × predicted G` |
| Calibration slope | Toward 1 | Scale agreement in the same regression |
| Effect RMSE | Lower | Secondary marker-effect recovery diagnostic |

Study 02 reports paired BayesR/BayesC and BED/CSR contrasts. Positive
advantages are oriented to favor the named focal method: correlation uses
`focal - comparison`; error metrics and absolute calibration error use
`comparison - focal`.

[Study 02 report](studies/02_prediction/report.qmd) ·
[`metric_prediction_correlation()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblrbench/blob/master/man/metric_prediction_correlation.Rd) ·
[`metric_prediction_nmse()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblrbench/blob/master/man/metric_prediction_nmse.Rd)

## Fine-mapping and prioritization

| Metric | Preferred direction | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| PIP Brier score | Lower | Mean squared error between marker PIP and binary causal truth |
| Effect RMSE | Lower | Error in posterior-mean marker effects |
| Average precision | Higher | Precision accumulated at causal-marker ranks after decreasing-PIP sorting |
| Causal-marker rank | Lower | Earlier one-based ranking of causal markers |
| Top-K causal recall | Higher | Fraction of causal markers among the top 10, 20, or 50 PIP-ranked markers |
| Credible-set size | Lower, conditional on coverage | Number of markers required to reach the registered cumulative PIP target |
| Exact credible-set coverage | Near the design target | Constructed sets containing the exact causal marker |
| LD-proxy coverage | Near the design target | Constructed sets containing an accepted causal proxy |
| Causal-locus detection | Higher | True causal loci that generated a credible set |

PIP ties are resolved by first occurrence in canonical marker order. Coverage
is conditional on constructed sets, whereas locus detection uses all true
causal loci as its denominator. These cumulative marginal-PIP sets are not
complete multi-effect posterior configurations.

[Study 01 report](studies/01_finemapping/report.qmd) ·
[`metric_average_precision()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblrbench/blob/master/man/metric_average_precision.Rd) ·
[`metric_causal_ranks()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblrbench/blob/master/man/metric_causal_ranks.Rd)

## Parameter recovery

| Metric | Preferred direction | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| Bias | Toward 0 | Posterior mean minus the registered realized truth |
| Absolute error | Lower | Magnitude of posterior-mean recovery error |
| RMSE | Lower | Root mean squared recovery error over matched coordinates |
| Interval width | Context dependent | Posterior uncertainty; narrower is not better without adequate coverage |
| Interval coverage | Near nominal | Registered truth inside the posterior interval |

Study 03 registers genetic variance, residual variance, heritability, base
effect variance, active probability, and a derived active-marker quantity.
Nonlinear estimands are calculated draw by draw before summarization.

[Study 03 report](studies/03_parameter_estimation/report.qmd) ·
[`plot_parameter_recovery()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblrbench/blob/master/man/plot_parameter_recovery.Rd)

## Convergence

| Diagnostic | Preferred direction | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| Rank-normalized R-hat | Toward 1 | Agreement among identifiable chains |
| Bulk ESS | Higher | Effective information for central posterior mass |
| Tail ESS | Higher | Effective information in posterior tails |
| MCSE | Lower | Monte Carlo uncertainty in a summary |
| Relative MCSE | Lower | MCSE relative to posterior variability |
| Burn-in stability | Stable | Agreement across registered burn-in choices |

Study 04 uses true chain traces. Posterior means, final states, pooled vectors,
and compact summaries are never substituted for unavailable traces. Candidate
windows are evaluated against frozen thresholds.

[Study 04 report](studies/04_convergence/report.qmd) ·
[`extract_convergence_traces()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblrbench/blob/master/man/extract_convergence_traces.Rd)

## LD-operator validation

| Metric family | Preferred direction | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| Relative Frobenius / maximum / diagonal error | Lower | Matrix approximation error against the registered reference |
| Symmetry and trace error | Lower | Preservation of basic operator identities |
| Corrected-score error | Lower | Difference in marker conditional scores |
| Quadratic / residual error | Lower | Difference in fixed-state quadratic and residual expressions |
| Retained spectral mass | Near target | Positive eigenvalue mass retained by the configured policy |
| Retained rank | Context dependent | Compression level, interpreted with accuracy and resource use |
| Recovery and runtime | Metric specific | Statistical behavior and computational cost under the tested operator |

Study 05 also records eigenvalue counts, effective rank, condition number,
storage, and convergence. These values describe its operators and data window;
they establish no universal sparsity, block, or rank policy.

[Study 05 report](studies/05_ld_operator/report.qmd) ·
[`operator_matrix_metrics()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblrbench/blob/master/man/operator_matrix_metrics.Rd) ·
[`operator_action_metrics()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblrbench/blob/master/man/operator_action_metrics.Rd)

## Annotation-informed metrics

| Metric family | Preferred direction | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| Annotation-prior contrast and correlation | Larger agreement with registered truth | Recovery of the common draw-wise marker-prior estimand |
| Causal-marker PIP and rank | Higher PIP; lower rank | Prioritization of true active markers |
| Top-K recovery, precision, and recall | Higher | Marker prioritization at registered cutoffs |
| Prediction and effect recovery | Metric specific | Genetic-signal recovery under matched baseline comparisons |
| Parameter recovery | Toward truth | Variance and heritability sanity checks |

These metrics are implemented for Study 06 development validation, but they
are **not supported by a completed benchmark**. The prespecified qualification
failed, the final grid was not launched, and the partial stop capsule supports
no method-performance claim.
